hooks.text: 接合同、处理遭遇、打捞回收、整备舰队，返航后还要结算账单与税费。
hooks.excerpt: Take a contract → choose how to handle encounters → salvage & recycle → refit your fleet → return, settle the bill, and head out again for bigger risks and bigger rewards.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 常规战斗可交给AI，也能手动集火和重定位；撤退本身是取胜条件的一部分。
hooks.excerpt: Let the AI handle routine combat, or take manual control to focus fire and reposition for an edge:
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: AI生成背景缺乏作品灵魂。

excerpts.excerpt: A.I. Generated backgrounds, which is what you're going to be looking at most of the time. Just play FTL instead, this is a low-budget copy without any of the soul.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 舰船与配件拖拽操作费劲且存在Bug。

excerpts.excerpt: 舰船和配件的拖拽特别特别费劲，一个一个拖就算了拖拽还有bug巨难受真的
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 什么时候增加战斗加速功能
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 配件装配缺少快捷方式。

excerpts.excerpt: 装配件也没有快捷方式也是一个一个拖
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 理解机制后可以克服初期看似严苛的难度。

excerpts.excerpt: The difficulty seems harsh at first, but can be overcome by understanding the game mechanics.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 作为自走棋的核心体验足够扎实。

excerpts.excerpt: 作为自走棋游戏本身就足够OK
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏循环能带来再开一局的吸引力。

excerpts.excerpt: The game gives me a 'one more run' feel just like FTL did
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 黑色幽默能缓解紧张氛围。

excerpts.excerpt: 黑色幽默总能在紧张的环境下逗人一笑
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
